name: pdfcpu-document-view-change-reports
instr:
pdfcpu cannot preview and safely apply combined page layout, page mode, and viewer preference changes with normalized, human-readable reports. Add shared planning and application without changing existing setter behavior.

The model package exposes PresentationValue(Present, Value), PresentationChange(Field, Before, After, Changed), PresentationRequest(PageLayout, PageMode, ViewerPreferences), PresentationPlan(SourceIdentity, Request, Changes), and PresentationOutcome(Applied, Changes). Preserve deterministic field ordering and explicit absent, supplied, unchanged, and changed states.

Planning reports normalized catalog effects for every requested family. Independently normalize layout, mode, and merged partial viewer preference differences in deterministic field order. Validate preferences against the source PDF version before any visible change. Version-invalid preferences abort combined requests before layout, mode, or output changes become visible. Matching partial preferences remain distinguishable from omission and apply as successful no-ops.

Base plan identity only on inspected presentation state. ApplyPresentationPlan and ApplyPresentationPlanFile reject mismatches with PresentationSourceChangedError(PlannedIdentity, ActualIdentity) from github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/pkg/api. Semantic no-ops return an unchanged PresentationOutcome without claiming modifications.
